answer: With a Dedicated device bound by attestation certificate with revocation on transfer, the account is only as strong as its binding: the dedicated device answers a fresh challenge, the attestation certificate is recorded, and revocation on transfer keeps one channel from spawning many identities, so losing the channel means losing the identity, and fakes cannot hide behind throwaway channels. One ledge proves nothing on its own; the proof is in the whole pattern of bindings. From the shale to the terrace, the same rule holds: no channel, no trust, no exception.
